subject: Starlabs: evidence playback & sample request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@starlabs.com>, security@starlabs.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starlabs: evidence playback & sample request

Sara — thanks again for the quick sync this morning. To keep the SIG/SOC2 intake moving we need an initial sample bundle and a short workback so our auditors can validate the controls. Specifically we are asking for: 

- SAML assertion samples (last 90 days) showing NameID, attributes, assertion timestamps and audience.
- SCIM delta snapshot covering changes to group membership and user provisioning for the same 90-day window.
- A role owner map (spreadsheet) that ties group names back to business owners and coarse-environment tags (prod/stage).

We can accept redacted samples (PII removed) — auditors expect real format/fields, not synthetic data. If you can provide a sample set scoped to a single tenant (or a small tenant subset) that will be enough to start. Please indicate any constraints (eg, we need a POA or internal approval) and an ETA.

Deliverables can be uploaded to the secure S3 path we shared in the portal or delivered via DocuSign if you prefer an official attestation. I copied Marissa who will coordinate the intake and redaction checklist on our side.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: request-checklist_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@starlabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@starlabs.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:40:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlabs: evidence playback & sample request

Kimberly — thanks, we can do that. Quick notes: 

1) We will need to scrub user emails and any employee identifiers before delivery; we typically replace them with stable pseudonyms (user_001, user_002). Is that acceptable to your auditors?
2) For SCIM deltas we can provide exactly the attributes you listed; file size for 90 days for our org is ~120MB. We can split into daily chunks if that helps.
3) Role owner map exists but will require a brief reconciliation; we can provide a snapshot and a short CSV explaining unresolved owners.

Tentative ETA: 48–72 hours for redacted bundle if we scope to 90 days and one tenant. We will upload to the secure S3 path and email you the link. If you need a signed attestation before upload, let us know and we can route through Legal.

—Sara
Sara Lin
Senior Security PM, Starlabs Inc.
sara.lin@starlabs.com

Attachment: starlabs-internal-approval-note.txt (txt)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:05:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlabs: evidence playback & sample request (internal)

Looping you both in — Sara confirmed they can deliver a redacted bundle within 48–72 hours if we accept pseudonymization. A couple of decisions for intake: 

- Scope: last 90 days, single tenant subset (agreed with Sara).
- Redaction: replace emails/usernames with stable pseudonyms, but keep timestamps and assertion fields intact (audience, issuer, NameID format). Auditors need to see assertion structure and timing.
- Format: SCIM deltas as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) split into ~10MB chunks; SAML as CSV of assertion fields; role map as .xlsx.

Marissa — can you stand up the compliance intake folder (S3) and the redaction checklist? Jordan — please review and sign off on the redaction script (we need consistent pseudonym mapping across SAML/SCIM exports).

I want to be able to hand this bundle to the auditor by EOD Thu (2026-06-18). If we can accelerate, great.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 15:22:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlabs: evidence playback & sample request — initial bundle

Sara / Kimberly — thanks, we have the initial bundle ready for upload. Per the intake checklist the package contains: 

1) saml_assertion_samples.csv (sampled assertions, NameID pseudonymized, timestamps preserved)
2) scim_delta_2026-05-15_to_2026-06-15.jsonl (NDJSON, split into 12 files, compressed)
3) role_owner_map_202605.xlsx (owner reconciliation sheet; unresolved owners flagged)
4) redaction_readme.txt (explains pseudonym mapping approach and fields removed)

I will upload the bundle to the S3 path: s3://redwood-compliance/starlabs/initial-bundle/ and set ACLs to the secure-audit bucket. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-compliance/starlabs/initial-bundle/?region=us-west-2

We also generated a small sample (saml_assertion_samples_preview.csv, ~20 rows) that auditors can review immediately — it is in the same folder. If Starlabs needs a signed attestation prior to upload we can pause; otherwise we'll proceed and notify Legal and the auditor when the files are live.

Next steps: Sara, please confirm receipt and whether you want us to route via DocuSign for a formal attestation. Jordan — please confirm the pseudonym mapping table looks correct; we'll keep a locked copy for audit traceability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
